title.narrative: Legal assistance and psychosocial support for vulnerable women and underaged persons in South Sudan
Rechtliche und psychosoziale Unterstützung für gefährdete Frauen und Minderjährige im Südsudan

description.narrative: Frauen und Minderjährige werden im Südsudan häufig auch für kleine Vergehen und ohne Gerichtsverfahren lange im Gefängnis oder im Polizeiarrest festgehalten. Women and minors in South Sudan are often detained in prison or police custody for long periods, even for minor offences and without trial. The aim is to provide legal support to women and minors in prison and police custody and to strengthen them through trauma counselling so that they are able to stand up for their rights with support. In addition to direct work with women and minors, which includes workshops, individual counselling and legal aid, police officers and public prosecutors are trained in trauma, gender-based violence and court proceedings.
